gauge_is_killed.meaning: the gauge has been killed via killGauge()

supply_index_frozen_at_prekill.meaning: supplyIndex[_gauge] remains frozen at its pre-kill value while the gauge is inactive

index_gap_grows.meaning: the gap between supplyIndex[gauge] and the global index grows with each notifyRewardAmount while the gauge is inactive

gauge_is_revived.meaning: the gauge has been revived via reviveGauge()

checkpoint_synchronized.meaning: the gauge-specific supplyIndex[_gauge] checkpoint is synchronized with the global index accumulator at kill/revive so no inactive-period delta remains

claims_unearned_rewards.meaning: the revived gauge is eligible to claim rewards it never earned, including rewards for epochs before it was killed

assumptions: killGauge() and reviveGauge() are the only transitions considered; no other synchronization path is assumed.
The inactive period spans at least one notifyRewardAmount so the index gap is nonzero.
Reward accrual during inactivity is measured against the frozen supplyIndex checkpoint.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric index/supplyIndex values or the reward formula, so the unearned amount cannot be quantified; the claim is kept at the eligibility/checkpoint-correspondence level.

limitations: Formalizes only the unearned_rewards impact; retroactive_claim and other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
Checkpoint synchronization is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the required correspondence qualitatively without numeric index values.
Caller identity for kill/revive is not constrained by the report and is not encoded.
